notes: Almost every source is an alexanarch record (#76, #74, #547, #1610, #569, #1529, #1677, #629, #1602, #1593, #1432, #93, #1750, #1584, #1605 etc.) or archive-internal data (registry.json, EA-WG-CAPTURES-01, EA-MPAI-ORTHONYM-01, kernel files), all excluded. Not entered: SHACL (line 248), named only as left for a later version, not relied on; SPXI's compressionSurvivalSummary field (line 87), Lee's own protocol, uncertain whether it counts as outside; the quoted AI reader outputs and reviews (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Grok, Qwen, DeepSeek; e.g. lines 224, 242, 244), which are reading sessions kept in the kernel's reader-runs/ package rather than published works. PROV-O and JSON-LD are named without authoring body, version or URL.
